# EliteBytes Tech

> EliteBytes Tech is a global IT solutions company providing managed IT services, cybersecurity, AI automation, web and mobile app development, Shopify store development, software development, and digital marketing. Based in Tirana, Albania — serving small and medium businesses in the US, UK, Europe, and worldwide.

## Services

- [Managed IT Services](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Proactive monitoring, maintenance, and expert IT support to keep your systems secure and running smoothly. Starting at $49.9/month.
- [Cybersecurity Services](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Endpoint detection, MFA setup, 24/7 threat monitoring, data backup and disaster recovery, and proactive risk management.
- [AI & Automation](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): AI-powered workflow automation, chatbots, intelligent analytics, and process optimization for businesses of all sizes.
- [Web & App Development](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Fast, secure, and scalable websites, web applications, and mobile apps for iOS and Android.
- [Shopify Store Development](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Full Shopify store development — custom design, product setup, payment integration, and SEO optimization. Ready in 7-14 days.
- [Software Development](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Custom software solutions, SaaS platforms, and enterprise applications tailored to your business goals.
- [Google & Meta Ads Management](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Full campaign management for Google Ads and Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Ads — targeting, creative, A/B testing, and reporting.
- [Social Media Management](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Content strategy, graphic design, daily posting, community management, and monthly analytics for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
- [Data Backup & Recovery](https://elitebytestech.com/it-services-small-business/): Secure cloud backup solutions and fast disaster recovery to protect your critical business data.

## About

EliteBytes Tech was founded with one mission: make enterprise-level technology accessible to businesses of every size, without the enterprise price tag. We serve clients globally — including the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, and across Europe — delivering Western-quality IT services at significantly more competitive prices.

- **Location**: Tirana, Albania (serving clients globally and remotely)
- **Response time**: Under 2 hours for critical issues
- **Support**: Monday–Friday, 9AM–6PM CET
- **Languages**: English, Albanian
- **Free consultation**: Available — no commitment required
